description:

But we reckon life goes beyond shoes. We believe itâs what you do in them that truly counts. So stay out late. Wake up early. Walk there, run back. Stand tall and be a champion in a crowd of Naysayers. Weâre for the ones that dance harder, sing louder and donât care what anyone else thinks. This is your story. Play Life Loud.

Platypus Shoes is a part of the Accent Group which is Australia and New Zealand's largest footwear group with over 900+ stores, 34 brands and 30+ online platforms including;, Platypus, Skechers, Hype DC, Vans, Dr. Martens, Subtype, The Athletes Foot,, Merrell, Timberland, Stylerunner, Hoka, UGG, Saucony, Sports Direct & Nude Lucy!

About The Role

As the Store Manager at Platypus Shoes Grand Plaza, you'll lead a team of passionate casual team members alongside your Assistant Store Manager. Your primary mission is to drive sales and KPIs, coach and inspire your team, and deliver an outstanding customer experience. You'll work closely with your Area Manager to identify and act on opportunities for growth, all while operating in a high-profile retail environment.

Key Responsibilities

Drive the overall performance of your store by achieving sales targets, KPIs, and maintaining visual merchandising standards.

Lead and motivate your team to deliver outstanding results in sales and customer service.

Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly sales, celebrating wins and identifying areas for improvement.

Manage rosters and wage costs in line with company targets and operational needs.

Coach and develop team members, ensuring ongoing training, high morale, and strong succession planning.

Oversee stock levels, store presentation, and operational excellence.

Ensure adherence to OH&S standards and legislation.

Skills And Experience

Demonstrated experience as a Store Manager or Assistant Store Manager in a high-volume retail environment

Strong leadership qualities with a results-focused and proactive mindset

Excellent communication and team development skills

Demonstrated ability to drive sales and manage store performance

Experience with stock management, operations, and visual merchandising

Passion for delivering an exceptional customer experience

Benefits

Work-Life Balance: Tuesday to Saturday roster â enjoy two consecutive days off

Career Growth: Extensive training and development programs to support your growth

Employee Perks: Access to our exclusive 'Employee Benefits' program â includes discounted gym memberships and health insurance.

Team Discounts: 40% off across all Accent Group brands including Platypus, Vans, Hype DC, Skechers, and more.

Supportive Culture: Be part of a vibrant, fun, and inclusive team culture with regular events, leadership conferences, and more.

At Accent Group Limited we are committed to creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity and inclusion. We believe in the diversity of our people across age, gender, identity, race, sexual orientation, ethnicity, physical and mental ability. We strive on creating an equal employment environment where everyone from any background can be themselves.
